responsibility: This file is the C++ implementation of the TI C6X target backend’s executable logic, providing the target hook bodies and helper routines that turn the macro/specification layer in c6x.h and the RTL patterns in c6x.md into concrete code-generation behavior. It owns C6X-specific option override and feature selection from -march and related flags, register and calling-convention decisions, address and constant legitimacy checks, small-data and section selection, builtin registration/expansion, operand printing and file/exception/unwind assembly emission, and machine-dependent reorganization. A major responsibility unique to this file in the module is the exposed-pipeline scheduling and modulo-scheduling support: it tracks per-insn scheduling metadata, implements custom scheduler hooks, reservation assignment, and final reordering/conditionalization logic for the C6X functional units, and then publishes all of these services through the TARGET_* hook table.
same_name_distinction: Implements the C6X backend’s executable target logic and hooks in code, culminating in the `targetm` initializer and functions for option override, legality checks, builtin expansion, assembly emission, reorg, and exposed-pipeline scheduling/modulo-scheduling support. Unlike `gcc/config/c6x/c6x.h` it is not the macro/specification header, unlike `gcc/config/c6x/c6x.md` it is not the declarative RTL pattern and attribute description, and unlike `gcc/config/c6x/c6x.opt` it does not define the generated command-line option table.
